reviews_captured_by_me.text: I am very happy with the quality of work performed by Jeff James on my bathroom remodeling.  He transformed an empty closet into a beautiful second bathroom.  He did everything from start to finish, which included the installation of the water lines, sewer line, sink, vanity, medicine cabinet, toilet, tiled shower stall, tiled walls and floor, and trim.  He really took pride in his work and never had the attitude of "that's good enough".  He was very helpful throughout the project and took the time to understand what I was looking to accomplish.  He is a perfectionist and it showed in the final product!  All work was scheduled and performed timely and as agreed.  He never left a mess and the only trace of him being there was that the bathroom was more complete than the day before.  I will definitely hire him for future projects....I highly recommend that you do too!

I would highly recommend Jeff to anyone who needed work done. He answered me and came out to give me a quote as soon as he was free. We had our shower tiled and he was very knowledgeable and did an amazing job with a lot of attention to detail. During the job he discovered our plumbing was not done properly and he corrected the issue, even if it meant he has to spend longer that day working. We love our new shower so much !
Very easy to work with and he works clean, never came home to a mess.  Great tile work.  Would definitely recommend.
